sections.label: For counsel
sections.title: Aviation disputes turn on what the records <t>can actually support.</t>
sections.intro: Aircraft condition, maintenance history and contractual obligation rarely align neatly by the time a matter reaches counsel. Establishing what happened requires someone who has read these records as the person accountable for them—and who can explain the findings plainly to lawyers, arbitrators and tribunals. Mark provides independent analysis, written reports and expert advice in commercial aviation matters. He is instructed by claimants and defendants alike, and is available as a single joint expert.

rows.d: Return conditions, pre-redelivery and redelivery findings, maintenance reserves, transition scope and the technical basis of claims between lessors, operators and purchasers.
Continuing airworthiness compliance, technical record integrity, back-to-birth traceability, maintenance programme adherence, workmanship and maintenance error.
Lease agreements, maintenance agreements and work scopes, MRO and OEM obligations, repossession and recovery, and the commercial consequences of technical findings.

std.label: Standards of practice
items: Instructed under CPR Part 35 — the expert’s duty is to the court, above the instructing party.
Expert evidence in arbitration, including proceedings under the IBA Rules.
Accepts instruction in England & Wales and internationally; written reports worldwide.
Initial response within one business day.
He does not opine on flight operations, piloting or air-traffic control.

cards.for: Managing or reviewing pre-redelivery, redelivery and onward delivery—scope, findings, negotiation with the MRO and control of cost and timing.

cards.title: Technical due diligence
cards.for: Pre-purchase inspections, mid-term audits and letter-of-intent inspections that establish the real condition and records position before value is committed.

cards.title: Repossession and recovery
cards.for: Aircraft repossession and recovery handled with a clear, calm and professional approach through difficult transitions.

cards.title: Records and asset management
